mapper.insert: INSERT INTO redemption_code (code, quota, status, created_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{quota}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, quota, status, created_by, used_by, used_time, create_time FROM redemption_code WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT id, code, quota, status, created_by, used_by, used_time, create_time FROM redemption_code WHERE code = #{code} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE redemption_code SET status = 3, used_by = #{usedBy}, used_time = NOW() WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, quota, status, created_by, used_by, used_time, create_time FROM redemption_code ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
